mapper.select: SELECT day_of_week AS dayOfWeek, effective_from AS effectiveFrom, is_open AS isOpen, open_time AS openTime, close_time AS closeTime, slot_minutes AS slotMinutes, break_minutes AS breakMinutes, default_capacity AS defaultCapacity FROM erp_bookstore_schedule WHERE center_code = #{centerCode} AND effective_from <= #{toDate} ORDER BY day_of_week ASC, effective_from ASC

SELECT day_of_week AS dayOfWeek, effective_from AS effectiveFrom, seq AS seq, start_time AS startTime, end_time AS endTime, capacity AS capacity FROM erp_bookstore_schedule_slot WHERE center_code = #{centerCode} AND effective_from <= #{toDate} ORDER BY day_of_week ASC, effective_from ASC, seq ASC

SELECT exception_id AS exceptionId, start_date AS startDate, end_date AS endDate, exception_type AS exceptionType, open_time AS openTime, close_time AS closeTime FROM erp_bookstore_schedule_exception WHERE center_code = #{centerCode} AND start_date <= #{toDate} AND end_date >= #{fromDate} ORDER BY start_date ASC, exception_id ASC

SELECT xs.exception_id AS exceptionId, xs.seq AS seq, xs.is_closed AS isClosed, xs.capacity AS capacity,
xs.start_time AS startTime, xs.end_time AS endTime FROM erp_bookstore_schedule_exception_slot xs JOIN erp_bookstore_schedule_exception x ON x.exception_id = xs.exception_id WHERE x.center_code = #{centerCode} AND x.start_date <= #{toDate} AND x.end_date >= #{fromDate} ORDER BY xs.exception_id ASC, xs.seq ASC
SELECT DISTINCT center_code FROM erp_bookstore_schedule ORDER BY center_code ASC
